en.title: iai in tăiai (you were cutting)
en.summary: This item illustrates the Romanian diphthong iai as found in the verb form tăiai.

sections.title: Sound of iai
paragraphs: The letters iai are spoken as the sound /jaj/. You hear this group in (tăiai) /təˈjaj/, which means you were cutting. This letter group makes only one combined sound in Romanian words. Listen to how smoothly the three letters blend together into one flowing unit.

sections.title: How to say iai
paragraphs: Lift your tongue high and forward near the roof of your mouth. Glide quickly down into a wide open mouth. Then glide your tongue high and forward again. Keep your vocal cords vibrating all the time. Feel the steady vibration by placing a hand on your throat.

sections.title: Spelling of iai
paragraphs: The letters iai make the sound /jaj/ in a single syllable. You hear this sound at the end of (apropiai) /a.pro.piˈjaj/. The group stays together as one flowing syllable in verb forms.

sections.title: Comparing iai
paragraphs: You might separate these letters into two distinct syllables. Do not pause between the letters. The whole sequence sounds like the word yay in English. Say it as one single continuous movement without any break.
